messages.author: accuratefreeenergy–––
messages.body:
Hi Pengfei,
About the bug you reported: you are right; the problem is in ti.F90 ~L970. The following line should be removed longtime ago…(although you may see OK results by adding a loop as you tried to do).
crd(m, atm_j) = crd(m, atm_i)
Please let me know if it fixes your crashes.
Thanks for pointing this out. I will submit a bug fix soon.
Taisung
